hero.title: Casa del Caballo Soñador | Boutique Hotel in Chacala, Nayarit

about.subtitle: The Sanctuary
about.title: Life moves slower, and nature sets the pace.
about.p1: Located in the vibrant heart of Chacala, Casa del Caballo Soñador offers an unparalleled experience for those seeking tranquility and connection.
about.p2: Our property has been designed with harmony with nature in mind, using sustainable local materials.

amenities.title: Designed for your comfort
amenities.palapa_desc: Open-air terrace for yoga, meditation, and panoramic Pacific views.
amenities.pool_desc: Central oasis with a waterfall jacuzzi under the palm trees.
amenities.kitchen_desc: Fully equipped shared kitchen for culinary experiences.
amenities.comfort_desc: Hot breakfast, fast Wi-Fi, A/C, and 6 mins from the beach.

concept.title: A Place to Pause, Breathe, and Belong
concept.p1: Inspired by the spirit of the dreaming horse—peaceful, untamed, and deeply connected—our space is a place to pause, breathe, and belong.
concept.p2: Crafted with care using local stone, warm wood, and soft natural linens, each of our six rooms reflects the quiet strength of the land around us. The architecture is simple yet soulful, with arched doorways, curved balconies, and textures that invite touch. Two rooms offer shaded terraces for enjoying the still mornings or golden light at day’s end.
concept.p3: At the heart of the property, a pool and waterfall jacuzzi offer cool relief under the palms. Views stretch to the ocean, just a short walk away, while birdsong and the scent of sun-warmed earth surround you.
concept.p4: Welcome to Casa del Caballo Soñador, a boutique hotel in a small Mexican fishing village where life moves slower and nature sets the rhythm.

items.title: 6 Private Rooms
items.short: Exclusive spaces designed for your rest.

toursPage.heroTitle: UNIQUE ATV TOURS TO THE LESS EXPLORED SIGHTS IN CHACALA
toursPage.introText1: Tucked away in a small cove along the Pacific coast in the State of Nayarit, Chacala stands out for its unique charm and pristine beauty. Providing a serene getaway, the town boasts uncrowded beaches and a welcoming ambiance.
toursPage.introText2: The town's name, meaning "where there are shrimp" in Nahuatl, reflects its connection to the local culture and abundant marine life, adding to the distinctive character of this coastal gem.

tours.title: Ojo de Agua
tours.description: Orchards to a pristine cold-water spring. Uncover hidden petroglyphs.

tours.title: Molote River
tours.description: Thermal inlets and refreshing downstream waters.

tours.title: El Capomo
tours.description: Plunge pool beneath a majestic 50ft jungle waterfall.

tours.title: Las Cuevas
tours.description: Hidden gem beneath a volcanic plug for uninterrupted beach time.

tours.title: Jumurrca
tours.description: Explore hidden paths and spectacular views of the local wildlife.

tours.title: Alta Vista

tours.title: Volcano
tours.description: Conquer the crater and experience breathtaking panoramic vistas.

toursPage.editorialText: Experience the untamed beauty of Riviera Nayarit. Our off-road expeditions are designed to connect you deeply with nature while preserving its pristine condition.

items.a: Chacala has about 300 full time resident with the population surging during Christmas and Semana Santa. Our town is very small, situated primarily around a small Bay and most hotels/residence are within a 6 minute walk of the beach.

Yes, we have a fully stocked shared kitchen with full size appliances and most of the amenities you would find at home. Each room is also equipped with a mini fridge/microwave. We also have a BBQ available on request.
We highly recommend DEET to repel mosquitoes. Smaller insects such as midges come out in the cooler hours of the evening.

items.q: What is the capacity of your Casa?
items.a: We can accommodate up to 14 people.

items.q: How do I get there from the airport?
items.a: You can rent a car or take a bus or taxi. We can assist with your arrangements.

items.q: Is there a drug store nearby?
items.a: There are several drug stores in Las Varas (10km from Chacala).
There is a hospital in nearby Las Varas (10 km from Chacala) as well as a medical clinic that is open Monday - Friday 8am - 4 pm.
Chacala has 3 bank machines and there are several large banks in nearby Las Varas.
We have several small grocers in Chacala, and larger grocery stores in nearby Las Varas.
Our town always has construction going on during the day, but evenings are normally quiet. Our Casa is closer to the jungle on the outskirts and tend to be quieter.
